title: Design: Active and Inactive tabs show counts as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure at least one term is deactivated.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design pictures ct-p1-01-active-tab-one-table.png, ct-p4-02-inactive-tab-the-rest.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Settings page.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Settings menu, click "Credit Terms".
  2. Click the "Inactive" tab.
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The page opens on "Active".
  • Each tab shows its label followed by a rounded count pill.
  • The selected tab, "Active", has blue text, a blue line under it and a light-blue pill.
  • "Inactive" has grey text and a light-grey pill (as in ct-p1-01-active-tab-one-table.png).

Step 2:

  • The blue text, blue line and light-blue pill move to "Inactive", and "Active" turns grey with a light-grey pill (as in ct-p4-02-inactive-tab-the-rest.png).

Step 3:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R3: “Below the header are two tabs, "Active" and "Inactive", each followed by a count of the terms in it. The page opens on Active.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "1 List and row menus" ("Active tab: one table"), page "4 Everything deactivated and an empty tab" ("Inactive tab: the rest"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p1-01-active-tab-one-table.png
  • ct-p4-02-inactive-tab-the-rest.png

The design's own words:

  • “Source: Payment Methods uses native tabs on its Settings page (Customer Payments / Vendor Payments, PaymentMethodsTabs.vue), and the Inventory list splits Active and Inactive into tabs (Parts Lifecycle Update PRD 829227015). Tab look matches the Inspection Templates tabs in production: label, then a rounded count pill (selected: blue text, blue underline, light blue pill; unselected: grey text, light grey pill), drawn with DS tokens and the DS Badge.”
